tips.text: Collect Death Marks from several different bosses, then play normally; repeating one boss does not stack marks.
Mark with fast Assassinations: The Sergeant on Iliad, Phobos, or the Hyena Pack on Psamathe, Neptune.
Run a squad where everyone holds a Death Mark and take turns on boss killing blows; each marked member raises the spawn chance.
Buy a Stalker Beacon whenever Baro stocks it; it is the only on-demand summon.
Ride the mark farm alongside other grinds like Lich murmur nodes or fissures instead of a dedicated session.
Land the killing blow yourself on each boss; a squadmate who finishes it gets the Death Mark, not you.
Ask the squad for a waypoint to Stalker's body and note any rare drop; host migration can eat it.
After a mark, run missions that last past five minutes, then re-mark with a fast Assassination.
Skip Captain Vor, Corrupted Vor, Ropalolyst, Zealoid Prelate, The Fragmented and H-09 Efervon Tank; they grant no Death Mark.
Expect wild variance: some players drop War on the first kill, others never see it in hundreds of hours.
Players find War underwhelming next to Broken War and build it for Mastery.
